application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use - offices to dwellinghouses
description: Prior notification for the change of use of the existing premises from offices (B1a use) to provide 132 self-contained residential flats (C3 use)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be completed within three years of the date of this granting of prior approval.

Condition : 2 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the first occupation of the flats hereby permitted, a Car Parking Management Plan (CMPM) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The CMPM shall include the following:
"	Measures to prevent parking in inappropriate locations.
"	A plan showing the layout of car park, including details of Electric Vehicle charging points for the bays at a proportion no less than 20% Active and 20% passive, at least 10% of spaces demarked for disabled persons, and removal of the parking bay closest to the car park ramp.
"	Measures for confirming how the existing spaces over and above the proposed ratio of 0.5 will be removed.
"	Details of how the car parking spaces will be allocated and managed to ensure maximum use
The CMPM shall then be implemented in accordance with the approved details before first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the first occupation of the flats hereby permitted, full details of cycle parking provision (including enclosure details) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout, and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first occupation of the flats hereby permitted, the local planning authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of Blue Badge holders, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the first occupation of the flats hereby permitted, full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  
These details shall include:
"	Facilities for pedestrians (e.g. dropped kerbs)
"	Safeguarding of potential future routes along and across the railway line to the south of the site

Condition : 9 - 9.	Prior to the first occupation of any part of the development hereby approved a Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
